mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to higher inflation expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real final sales (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals strong consumer demand, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS QoQ > GDPC1 QoQ and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, which is a positive indicator for consumer spending and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 0 and UNRATE MoM < 0, and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, which is a positive indicator for liquidity in the markets and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS MoM < 0 and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) both show a quarter-over-quarter decline, it signals a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO QoQ < 0 and GDPC1 QoQ < 0, and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
